title: B01 Driver Certificate of Competence (Animal Welfare)
description: Certificate of competence for drivers and attendants of road vehicles transporting domestic Equidae, bovine, ovine, caprine, porcine animals or poultry (Art. 6(5), 17(2)).

x-traced.status: pre-project draft — subject to change in T4.1
consolidates: B01 Driver Certificate of Competence (Animal Welfare)
x-traced.issuer: Competent authority or designated body of the Member State (Art. 17(2)); training and independent examination per Annex IV.
x-traced.holder: In the pilot: held in the transporter's legal-entity wallet with the driver as subject, linked to the transporter by the mandate credential defined in T2.4 / D1.1.
verifiers: Competent authority of the place of departure (Art. 14(1)(a)(i))
Official veterinarians at control posts and exit points (Art. 21(1)(b))
Competent authority granting a Type 2 authorisation (Art. 11(1)(b)(i))
legalBasis: Reg (EC) No 1/2005 Annex III, Chapter III (specimen certificate)
x-traced.forwardCompatibility: COM(2023) 770 (proposal) — forward-compatibility only: certificate of competence provisions; mapping in T2.1.
useCases: UC-3 official verification at control points
openQuestions: Holder model for a natural-person credential used in a legal-entity context (T2.4): transporter wallet + mandate credential vs. the driver's own EUDI Wallet.

person.description: The driver or attendant. Personal data: disclosed only for identity matching at a check.

speciesScope.description: Species or group of species the certificate covers (Art. 17(2) allows limitation).

issuingAuthorityOrBody.description: Competent authority or body designated by the Member State (Art. 17(2)).

validUntil.description: End of validity where national rules set one (Reg (EC) No 1/2005 sets none).
